name: Crate
author: Diego 🥷🏻
summary: The Crate mark on the QS Bar: now playing, transport and Crate's equalizer, shown while Crate is installed.
description: The Crate logo on the QS Bar, shown only while the Crate app is installed and animated while it plays. Its panel is drawn to Crate's player spec: an all-caps ticker title, transport, a 1 px progress beam, and Crate's equalizer (Smart, Genre, Adaptive, presets and the band curve), over Crate's desktop control socket and MPRIS. Part of Crate for Ryoku.
tagline: Now playing, transport and Crate's equalizer on the QS Bar.
